shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright pillar/stele
disc or circle motif in relief
horizontal band or belt-like register crossing the surface
arms/limbs bent and converging toward the front of the pillar
stacked registers of motifs one above another
justification: Both show an upright anthropomorphic pillar carved in low relief with a disc-like element above a horizontal belt/band, with bent arms converging below and further motifs stacked beneath — a distinctive shared scheme of disc-over-belt on a body-like shaft. The biggest difference is that B carries a rich menagerie of profile animals (quadrupeds, birds, a long-necked bird, plant-like forms) and arcaded top register, none of which appear on A, whose surface is otherwise plain apart from the belt, arms and a small boss.
